title: USC Academic Calendar 2026-2027
source: USC Academic Calendar (Office of Academic Records and Registrar)
verification_note: Confirmed by a human (the user) on 2026-11-14: every date in this file (Fall 2026, Spring 2027, Summer 2027) was compared with the official calendar at https://www.usc.edu/academic-calendar/ and matched. Each term's source_text is checked against the Registrar's page snapshot. The business-day and academic-week definitions below are still unverified.

business_days.definition: Monday to Friday, excluding the university holidays listed in this file
business_days.note: No source defines 'business days' for USG or Campus Activities deadlines. Greenlight assumes Monday to Friday minus the university holidays listed here, and counts recess days (winter and spring recess) as business days because offices stay open. Both assumptions need confirming; dates counted in business days are shown yellow until then.

academic_weeks.note: USG counts its deadlines in academic weeks but does not define them; the Funding Application Deadlines table that does needs a USC sign-in (rule usg-academic-week-definition). Greenlight does not compute academic-week dates as certain.
